items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Nancy Stovall, but the interviewee (Teddy Edwards) does not respond with any personal connection or recognition, only reacting to the subsequent mention of Kenny Bright and Dexter Gordon.

ctx.x: Anyway, I had a lot of nice things going on over there on Sundays and Tuesday evenings.

There was a person named Nancy Stovall who ...(?)... ...(?)... I remember a photograph taken in a photography magazine of Kenny Bright and I think Dexter Gordon, and I remember there was vapor coming out of Kenny Bright's horn.
